purpose: Measure the unchanged point method after newly audited January2025 observations can enter origin history. Compare both input versions on exactly identical available measured targets.
selection: Source acceptance uses provenance and conservative data-quality rules. No model, radius, feature, threshold or method is fitted or selected using these diagnostic outcomes.
calibration: Keep all original radii and sample counts unchanged after proving input/label equality through July2022. Unsupported ranges are withheld by a calibration-only tail-support disclosure rule.
limitations: The January2026 target values were inspected previously; this is an expanded retrospective diagnostic, not a new blind holdout or independent evaluation period.
Overlapping targets and repeated districts are not independent cases.
Reporting dates do not prove source publication availability at each origin.
No target history enters pseudo-cold references, and no pretrained XGBoost is used for that experiment.
Absent target labels for newly monitored districts do not establish their forecast skill.
